description_en: Queries a list of remediation templates for a managed rule
description_zh: 获取修正模板列表信息
kebab_example: aliyun config list-remediation-templates --remediation-type OOS --managed-rule-identifier oss-bucket-public-write-prohibited --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRemediationTemplates

parameters.help_en: The type of the remediation template. Valid value: OOS, which stands for Operation Orchestration Service
parameters.help_zh: 修正类型。仅支持OOS（运维编排）
parameters.name: remediation_type

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the managed rule.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261176.html operation to obtain the managed rule identifier
parameters.help_zh:
规则模板标识。

关于如何获取规则模板标识，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261176.html
parameters.name: managed_rule_identifier

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1
parameters.help_zh: 修正模板列表的页码。起始值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

取值范围：1~100，默认值：20
parameters.name: page_size
